  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(String name, GameRegion gameRegion, List<Location> spawns, Location lobbySign, int gameTimerTask, int minPlayers, int maxPlayers, int roam, boolean isReady, int cost)
      Create a new game

      Internally used when loading from config on server start

      Parameters:
      name - Name of this game
      gameRegion - Bounding region of this game
      spawns - List of spawns for this game
      lobbySign - Location of lobby sign block
      gameTimerTask - Length of the game (in seconds)
      minPlayers - Minimum players to be able to start the game
      maxPlayers - Maximum players that can join this game
      roam - Roam time for this game
      isReady - If the game is ready to start
      cost - Cost of this game
